codes.heading: Läromedelstyp
codes.notes: Swedish bookselling educational subject type

codes.heading: Förhandsbeskrivning
codes.notes: Swedish publishers preliminary subject classification

codes.heading: Spanish ISBN UDC subset
codes.notes: Controlled subset of UDC codes used by the Spanish ISBN Agency

codes.heading: ECI subject categories
codes.notes: Subject categories defined by El Corte Inglés and used widely in the Spanish book trade

codes.heading: Soggetto CCE
codes.notes: Classificazione commerciale editoriale (Italian book trade subject category based on BIC). CCE documentation available at https://www.ie-online.it/CCE2_2.0.pdf

codes.heading: Qualificatore geografico CCE
codes.notes: CCE Geographical qualifier

codes.heading: Qualificatore di lingua CCE
codes.notes: CCE Language qualifier

codes.heading: Qualificatore di periodo storico CCE
codes.notes: CCE Time Period qualifier

codes.heading: Qualificatore di livello scolastico CCE
codes.notes: CCE Educational Purpose qualifier

codes.heading: Qualificatore di età di lettura CCE
codes.notes: CCE Reading Level Qualifier

codes.heading: GREP Fagkoder
codes.notes: Codes for Norwegian educational subject categories (‘fagkoder’), used in primary and secondary education. See https://www.udir.no/ and https://data.udir.no/kl06/v201906/fagkoder

codes.heading: JEL classification
codes.notes: Journal of Economic Literature classification scheme

codes.heading: CSH
codes.notes: National Library of Canada subject heading (English)

codes.heading: RVM
codes.notes: Répertoire de vedettes-matière Bibliothèque de l’Université Laval) (French)

codes.heading: YKL
codes.notes: Finnish Public Libraries Classification System (Finnish: Yleisten kirjastojen luokitusjärjestelmä). See https://finto.fi/ykl/fi/ (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/ykl/sv/ (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/ykl/en/ (in English)

codes.heading: YSO
codes.notes: General Finnish Ontology (Finnish: Yleinen suomalainen ontologia). See https://finto.fi/yso/fi/ (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/yso/sv/ (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/yso/en/ (in English)

codes.heading: PTO
codes.notes: Finnish Geospatial Domain Ontology (Finnish: Paikkatieto ontologia). See https://finto.fi/pto/fi/ (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/pto/sv/ (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/pto/en/ (in English)

codes.heading: Suomalainen kirja-alan luokitus
codes.notes: Finnish book trade categorization

codes.heading: Sears
codes.notes: Sears List of Subject Headings

codes.heading: CSR
codes.notes: Code Sujet Rayon: subject categories used by bookstores in France

codes.heading: Suomalainen oppiaineluokitus
codes.notes: Finnish school subject categories. See https://www.onixkeskus.fi/media/f/5722

codes.heading: Japanese book trade C-Code
codes.notes: See https://isbn.jpo.or.jp/doc/08.pdf#page=44 (in Japanese)

codes.heading: Fiktiivisen aineiston lisäluokitus
codes.notes: Finnish fiction genre classification. See https://finto.fi/ykl/fi/page/fiktioluokka (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/ykl/sv/page/fiktioluokka (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/ykl/en/page/fiktioluokka (in English)

codes.heading: Arabized BIC subject category
codes.notes: Arabized version of BIC subject category scheme developed by ElKotob.com

codes.heading: Arabized LC subject headings
codes.notes: Arabized version of Library of Congress scheme

codes.heading: Bibliotheca Alexandrina Subject Headings
codes.notes: Classification scheme used by Library of Alexandria

codes.heading: Postal code
codes.notes: Location defined by postal code. Format is two-letter country code (from List 91), space, postal code. Note some postal codes themselves contain spaces, eg ‘GB N7 9DP’ or ‘US 10125’

codes.heading: GeoNames ID
codes.notes: ID number for geographical place, as defined at http://www.geonames.org (eg 2825297 is Stuttgart, Germany, see http://www.geonames.org/2825297)

codes.heading: NewBooks Subject Classification
codes.notes: Used for classification of academic and specialist publication in German-speaking countries. See http://www.newbooks-services.com/de/top/unternehmensportrait/klassifikation-und-mapping.html (German) and http://www.newbooks-services.com/en/top/about-newbooks/classification-mapping.html (English)

codes.heading: Chinese Library Classification
codes.notes: Subject classification maintained by the Editorial Board of Chinese Library Classification. See http://cct.nlc.gov.cn for access to details of the scheme

codes.heading: NTCPDSAC Classification
codes.notes: Subject classification for Books, Audiovisual products and E-publications formulated by China National Technical Committee 505

codes.heading: Season and Event Indicator
codes.notes: German code scheme indicating association with seasons, holidays, events (eg Autumn, Back to School, Easter)

codes.heading: GND
codes.notes: (de: Gemeinsame Normdatei) Integrated Authority File used in the German-speaking countries. See https://www.dnb.de/DE/Professionell/Standardisierung/GND/gnd_node.html (German) and https://www.dnb.de/EN/Professionell/Standardisierung/GND/gnd_node.html (English). Combines the PND, SWD and GKD into a single authority file, and should be used in preference to the older codes

codes.heading: BIC UKSLC
codes.notes: UK Standard Library Categories, the successor to BIC’s E4L classification scheme. See https://bic.org.uk/resources/uk-standard-library-categories/

codes.heading: Thema subject category
codes.notes: International multilingual subject category scheme – see https://ns.editeur.org/thema

codes.heading: Thema interest age / special interest qualifier
Ämnesord
codes.notes: Swedish subject categories maintained by Bokrondellen

codes.heading: Statystyka Książek Papierowych, Mówionych I Elektronicznych
codes.notes: Polish Statistical Book and E-book Classification

codes.heading: CCSS
codes.notes: Common Core State Standards curriculum alignment, for links to US educational standards. <SubjectCode> uses the full dot notation. See http://www.corestandards.org/developers-and-publishers

codes.heading: Rameau
codes.notes: French library subject headings

codes.heading: Nomenclature discipline scolaire
codes.notes: French educational subject classification, URI http://data.education.fr/voc/scolomfr/scolomfr-voc-015GTPX

codes.heading: ISIC
codes.notes: International Standard Industry Classification, a classification of economic activities. Use for books that are about a particular industry or economic activity. <SubjectCode> should be a single letter denoting an ISIC section OR a 2-, 3- or 4-digit number denoting an ISIC division, group or class. See http://unstats.un.org/unsd/cr/registry/isic-4.asp

codes.heading: LC Children’s Subject Headings
codes.notes: Library of Congress Children’s Subject Headings: LCSHAC supplementary headings for Children’s books

codes.heading: Ny Läromedel
codes.notes: Swedish bookselling educational subject

codes.heading: EuroVoc
codes.notes: EuroVoc multilingual thesaurus. <SubjectCode> should be a EuroVoc concept dc:identifier (for example, 2777, ‘refrigerated products’). See http://eurovoc.europa.eu

codes.heading: BISG Educational Taxonomy
codes.notes: Controlled vocabulary for educational objectives. See https://www.bisg.org/products/recommendations-for-citing-educational-standards-and-objectives-in-metadata

codes.heading: Keywords (not for display)
codes.notes: For indexing and search purposes, MUST not be displayed. Where multiple keywords or keyword phrases are sent, this should be in a single instance of the <SubjectHeadingText> element, and it is recommended that they should be separated by semi-colons. Use of code B2 should be very rare: use B2 in preference to code 20 only where it is important to show the keyword list is specifically NOT for display to purchasers (eg some keywords for a medical textbook may appear offensive if displayed out of context)

codes.heading: Nomenclature Diplôme
codes.notes: French higher and vocational educational subject classification, URI http://data.education.fr/voc/scolomfr/scolomfr-voc-029

codes.heading: Key character names
codes.notes: For fiction and non-fiction, one or more key names, provided – like keywords – for indexing and search purposes. Where multiple character names are sent, this should be in a single instance of <SubjectHeadingText>, and multiple names should be separated by semi-colons. Note <NameAsSubject> should be used for people who are the central subject of the book. Code B4 may be used for names of lesser importance

codes.heading: Key place names
codes.notes: For fiction and non-fiction, one or more key names, provided – like keywords – for indexing and search purposes. Where multiple place names are sent, this should in a single instance of <SubjectHeadingText>, and multiple names should be separated by semi-colons. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: FAST
codes.notes: Faceted Application of Subject Terminology, OCLC subject scheme derived from LCSH (see code 04). See https://fast.oclc.org/fast/. Codes are up to 8 digits, for example 1726640 for Historical fiction (see https://id.worldcat.org/fast/1726640). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: NGSS
codes.notes: Next Generation Science Standards for K-12 education in the USA (https://www.nextgenscience.org). <SubjectCode> is a code such as 4-PS3-2. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: MVB-Lesemotive
codes.notes: MVB classification of ‘reading rationales’, which classify unconscious motives that lead to a book purchase. Categories are assigned and maintained by MVB. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://vlb.de/lesemotive

codes.heading: LOPS21 Subject module
codes.notes: Finnish Suomalainen oppiaineluokitus. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Læreplaner-LK20
codes.notes: Codes for Norwegian curriculum for primary and secondary education. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See Læreplaner-LK20 at https://www.udir.no/om-udir/data/kl06-grep/

codes.heading: Kompetansemål-LK20
codes.notes: Codes for competency aims in the Norwegian curriculum for primary and secondary education. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See Kompetansemål-LK20 at https://www.udir.no/om-udir/data/kl06-grep/

codes.heading: Kompetansemålsett-LK20
codes.notes: Codes for sets of competency aims in the Norwegian curriculum for primary and secondary education. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See Kompetansemålsett-LK20 at https://www.udir.no/om-udir/data/kl06-grep/

codes.heading: Tverrfaglige temaer-LK20
codes.notes: Codes for interdisciplinary topics in the Norwegian curriculum for primary and secondary education. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See Tverrfaglige temaer-LK20 at https://www.udir.no/om-udir/data/kl06-grep/

codes.heading: CLIL – Type d’article scolaire
codes.notes: Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: GAR – Type pédagogique
codes.notes: Gestionnaire d’Accès aux resources – see https://gar.education.fr/ Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: ISCED-F
codes.notes: UNESCO ISCED Fields of education and training (2013), eg <SubjectCode> 0222 is ‘History and archaeology’. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See http://uis.unesco.org/sites/default/files/documents/international-standard-classification-of-education-fields-of-education-and-training-2013-detailed-field-descriptions-2015-en.pdf

codes.heading: Klassifikationen von Spielen, Puzzles und Spielwaren
codes.notes: German category scheme for games, puzzles and toys. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://www.ludologie.de/fileadmin/user_upload/PDFs/211126_Kategorisierung_von_Spielen_Puzzles_und_Spielwaren.pdf

codes.heading: NBVok NTSF
codes.notes: National Library of Norway genre and form thesaurus. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://www.nb.no/nbvok/ntsf

codes.heading: JPRO Genre
codes.notes: Subject / genre code used in Japan. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: KAUNO
codes.notes: Finnish Ontology for fiction (Finnish: Fiktiivisen aineiston ontologia). See https://finto.fi/kauno/fi/ (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/kauno/sv/ (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/kauno/en/ (in English). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: SLM
codes.notes: Finnish genre and form vocabulary (Finnish: Suomalainen lajityyppi ja muotosanasto). See https://finto.fi/slm/fi/ (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/slm/sv/ (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/slm/en/ (in English). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: YSO-places
codes.notes: General Finnish Ontology for Places (Finnish: Yleinen suomalainen ontologia – paikat). See https://finto.fi/yso-paikat/fi/ (in Finnish), https://finto.fi/yso-paikat/sv/ (in Swedish), https://finto.fi/yso-paikat/en/ (in English). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Norske emneord
codes.notes: See https://www.nb.no/nbvok/nb/. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Austlang
codes.notes: Controlled vocabulary and alphanumeric codes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages and peoples, maintained by the Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies (AIATSIS), for use where the book is about a language or the people that traditionally speak it. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://collection.aiatsis.gov.au/austlang

codes.heading: German Tropes list
codes.notes: Used for tropes (recurring themes, motifs, patterns of behavior and/or character traits of the main character(s) that run through a work) in German-speaking countries. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://www.boersenverein.de/interessengruppen/ig-produktmetadaten/best-practices/

codes.heading: General / adult
codes.notes: For a non-specialist or ‘popular’ adult audience. Consider also adding an ONIX Adult audience rating

codes.heading: Children
codes.notes: For a young audience typically up to about the age of 12, not specifically for any educational purpose. An audience range should also be included

codes.heading: Teenage
codes.notes: For a teenage or ‘young adult’ audience typically from about the age of 12 to the late teens, not specifically for any educational purpose. An audience range should also be included

codes.heading: Primary and secondary education
codes.notes: Kindergarten, pre-school, primary / elementary or secondary / high school education. Note ‘secondary’ includes both level 2 and level 3 secondary education as defined in UNESCO’s ISCED 2011 (see https://www.uis.unesco.org/en/methods-and-tools/isced). An audience range should also be included

codes.heading: Pre-primary education
codes.notes: Equivalent to UNESCO’s ISCED Level 0 – see https://www.uis.unesco.org/en/methods-and-tools/isced (note codes 11–14 are specific subsets of the Primary and secondary education audience, code 04). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Primary education
codes.notes: Equivalent to ISCED Level 1. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Lower secondary education
codes.notes: Equivalent to ISCED Level 2 (general and vocational). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Upper secondary education
codes.notes: Equivalent to ISCED Level 3 (general and vocational). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Tertiary education
codes.notes: For tertiary education typically in universities and colleges of higher education, equivalent to ISCED Levels 5–7

codes.heading: Professional and scholarly
codes.notes: For an expert adult audience, including professional development and academic research

codes.heading: Adult education
codes.notes: For any adult audience in a formal or semi-formal learning setting, eg vocational training and apprenticeships (collectively, equivalent to ISCED Level 4), or practical or recreational learning for adults

codes.heading: EFL / TEFL / TESOL
codes.notes: Intended for use in teaching and learning English as a second, non-native or additional language. Indication of the language level (eg CEFR) should be included where possible. An audience range should also be included if the product is (also) suitable for use in primary and secondary education

codes.heading: Second / additional language teaching
codes.notes: Intended for use in teaching and learning second, non-native or additional languages (other than English), for example teaching German to Spanish speakers. Indication of the language level (eg CEFR) should be included where possible. An audience range should also be included if the product is (also) suitable for use in primary and secondary education. Prefer code 07 for products specific to teaching English

codes.heading: ONIX audience codes
codes.notes: Using a code from List 28

codes.heading: Proprietary audience scheme
codes.notes: For example, a publisher’s or retailer’s own audience coding scheme. Note that a distinctive <AudienceCodeTypeName> is required with proprietary coding schemes

codes.heading: MPAA rating
codes.notes: Motion Picture Association of America rating applied to movies

codes.heading: BBFC rating
codes.notes: British Board of Film Classification rating applied to movies

codes.heading: FSK rating
codes.notes: German FSK (Freiwillige Selbstkontrolle der Filmwirtschaft) rating applied to movies

codes.heading: BTLF audience code
codes.notes: French Canadian audience code list, used by BTLF for Memento

codes.heading: Electre audience code
codes.notes: Audience code used by Electre (France)

codes.heading: ANELE Tipo
codes.notes: Spain: educational audience and material type code of the Asociación Nacional de Editores de Libros y Material de Enseñanza

codes.heading: AVI
codes.notes: Code list used to specify reading levels for children’s books, used in Flanders, and formerly in the Netherlands – see also code 18

codes.heading: USK rating
codes.notes: German USK (Unterhaltungssoftware Selbstkontrolle) rating applied to video or computer games

codes.heading: AWS
codes.notes: Audience code used in Flanders

codes.heading: Suomalainen kouluasteluokitus
codes.notes: Finnish school or college level

codes.heading: CBG age guidance
codes.notes: UK Publishers Association, Children’s Book Group, coded indication of intended reader age, carried on book covers

codes.heading: BookData audience code
codes.notes: Audience code used in NielsenIQ BookData services

codes.heading: AVI (revised)
codes.notes: Code list used to specify reading levels for children’s books, used in the Netherlands – see also code 09

codes.heading: Japanese Children’s audience code
codes.notes: Children’s audience code (対象読者), two-digit encoding of intended target readership from 0–2 years up to High School level

codes.heading: ONIX Adult audience rating
codes.notes: Publisher’s rating indicating suitability for a particular adult audience, using an <AudienceCodeValue> from List 203. Should only be used when the ONIX Audience code indicates a general adult audience (code 01 from List 28)

codes.heading: Common European Framework of Reference for Language Learning (CEFR)
codes.notes: Codes Pre-A1 to C2 indicating standardized level of language learning or teaching material, from beginner to advanced, defined by the Council of Europe (see https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages). For products spanning levels, use a hyphen, eg A1-A2+

codes.heading: Korean Publication Ethics Commission rating
codes.notes: Rating used in Korea to control selling of books and e-books to minors. Current values are 0 (suitable for all) and 19 (only for sale to ages 19+). See http://www.kpec.or.kr/english/

codes.heading: FSK Lehr-/Infoprogramm
codes.notes: Used for German videos / DVDs with educational or informative content; value for <AudienceCodeValue> must be either ‘Infoprogramm gemäß § 14 JuSchG’ or ‘Lehrprogramm gemäß § 14 JuSchG’

codes.heading: Intended audience language
codes.notes: Where this is different from the language of the text of the book recorded in <Language>. <AudienceCodeValue> should be a value from List 74

codes.heading: PEGI rating
codes.notes: Pan European Game Information rating used primarily for video games

codes.heading: Gymnasieprogram
codes.notes: Code indicating the intended curriculum (eg Naturvetenskapsprogrammet, Estetica programmet) in Swedish higher secondary education

codes.heading: ISCED 2011
codes.notes: International Standard Classification of Education levels (2011), eg <AudienceCodeValue> 253 is ‘Lower secondary vocational education, level completion without direct access to upper secondary education’. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See http://uis.unesco.org/en/topic/international-standard-classification-education-isced

codes.heading: US school grade range
codes.notes: Values for <AudienceRangeValue> are specified in List 77

codes.heading: UK school grade
codes.notes: Values are to be defined by BIC for England and Wales, Scotland and N Ireland

codes.heading: Reading speed, words per minute
codes.notes: Values in <AudienceRangeValue> must be integers

codes.heading: Interest age, months
codes.notes: For use up to 36 months only, or up to 42 months in Audience range value (2) only: values in <AudienceRangeValue> must be integers. Should not be used when an Audience range with qualifier code 17 is present

codes.heading: Interest age, years
codes.notes: Values in <AudienceRangeValue> must be integers

codes.heading: Reading age, years
codes.notes: Values in <AudienceRangeValue> must be integers

codes.heading: Spanish school grade
codes.notes: Spain: combined grade and region code, maintained by the Ministerio de Educación

codes.heading: Skoletrinn
codes.notes: Bokbasen educational level for primary and secondary education

codes.heading: Nivå
codes.notes: Swedish educational qualifier (code)

codes.heading: Canadian school grade range
codes.notes: Values for <AudienceRangeValue> are specified in List 77

codes.heading: Finnish Upper secondary school course
codes.notes: Lukion kurssi

codes.heading: Chinese School Grade range
codes.notes: Values are P, K, 1–17 (including college-level audiences), see List 227

codes.heading: French school cycles / classes
codes.notes: Detailed French educational level classification. Values are defined by ScoLOMFR, see http://data.education.fr/voc/scolomfr/scolomfr-voc-022 – Cycles de l’enseignement scolaire. See also code 34

codes.heading: Brazil Education level
codes.notes: Nível de Educação do Brasil, see List 238. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: French educational levels
codes.notes: Basic French educational level classification. Values are defined by ScoLOMFR. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See http://data.education.fr/voc/scolomfr/scolomfr-voc-012

codes.heading: Finnish Upper secondary school course (2021+)
codes.notes: Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Detailed French educational levels
codes.notes: Detailed French educational level classification. Values are defined by ScoLOMFR. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See http://data.education.fr/voc/scolomfr/scolomfr-voc-022 – Niveau éducatif détaillé. See also code 30

codes.heading: GREP Årstrinn
codes.notes: Norwegian educational level for primary and secondary education. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://www.udir.no/ and https://data.udir.no/kl06/v201906/aarstrinn/

codes.heading: Proprietary name ID scheme
codes.notes: For example, a publisher’s own name, contributor or imprint ID scheme. Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with proprietary identifiers

codes.heading: DNB publisher identifier
codes.notes: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek publisher identifier

codes.heading: Börsenverein Verkehrsnummer
codes.notes: (de: Verkehrsnummer ded Börsenverein des deutschen Buchhandels)

codes.heading: German ISBN Agency publisher identifier
codes.notes: (de: MVB-Kennnummer)

codes.heading: GLN
codes.notes: GS1 global location number (formerly EAN location number)

codes.heading: SAN
codes.notes: Book trade Standard Address Number – US, UK etc

codes.heading: MARC organization code
codes.notes: MARC code list for organizations – see http://www.loc.gov/marc/organizations/orgshome.html

codes.heading: Centraal Boekhuis Relatie ID
codes.notes: Trading party identifier used in the Netherlands

codes.heading: Distributeurscode Boekenbank
codes.notes: Flemish supplier code. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Fondscode Boekenbank
codes.notes: Flemish publisher code

codes.heading: Y-tunnus
codes.notes: Business Identity Code (Finland). See http://www.ytj.fi/ (in Finnish)

codes.heading: ISNI
codes.notes: International Standard Name Identifier. A sixteen digit number. Usually presented with spaces or hyphens dividing the number into four groups of four digits, but in ONIX the spaces or hyphens should be omitted. See https://isni.org/

codes.heading: NACO
codes.notes: A control number assigned to a Library of Congress Control Number (LCCN) Name Authority / NACO record

codes.heading: Japanese Publisher identifier
codes.notes: Publisher identifier administered by Japanese ISBN Agency

codes.heading: ORCID
codes.notes: Open Researcher and Contributor ID. A sixteen digit number. Usually presented with hyphens dividing the number into four groups of four digits, but in ONIX the hyphens should be omitted. See http://www.orcid.org/

codes.heading: GAPP Publisher Identifier
codes.notes: Publisher identifier maintained by the Chinese ISBN Agency (GAPP)

codes.heading: VAT Identity Number
codes.notes: Identifier for a business organization for VAT purposes, eg within the EU’s VIES system. See http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/faqvies.do for EU VAT ID formats, which vary from country to country. Generally these consist of a two-letter country code followed by the 8–12 digits of the national VAT ID. Some countries include one or two letters within their VAT ID. See http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VAT_identification_number for non-EU countries that maintain similar identifiers. Spaces, dashes etc should be omitted

codes.heading: JP Distribution Identifier
codes.notes: 4-digit business organization identifier controlled by the Japanese Publication Wholesalers Association

codes.heading: GND
codes.notes: Gemeinsame Normdatei – Joint Authority File in the German-speaking countries. See http://www.dnb.de/EN/gnd (English). Combines the PND, SWD and GKD into a single authority file, and should be used in preference

codes.heading: DUNS
codes.notes: Dunn and Bradstreet Universal Numbering System, see http://www.dnb.co.uk/dandb-duns-number

codes.heading: Ringgold ID
codes.notes: Ringgold organizational identifier, see http://www.ringgold.com/identify.html

codes.heading: Identifiant Editeur Electre
codes.notes: French Electre publisher identifier

codes.heading: EIDR Party ID
codes.notes: Entertainment Identifier Registry party identifier (a DOI beginning ‘10.5237/’ with a suffix of 8 hexadecimal digits and one hyphen, and without the https://doi.org/ or the older http://dx.doi.org/), for example ‘10.5237/C9F6-F41F’ (Sam Raimi). See http://eidr.org

codes.heading: Identifiant Marque Electre
codes.notes: French Electre imprint Identifier

codes.heading: VIAF ID
codes.notes: Virtual Internet Authority File. <IDValue> should be a number. The URI form of the identifier can be created by prefixing the number with ‘https://viaf.org/viaf/’. See https://viaf.org

codes.heading: FundRef DOI
codes.notes: DOI used in CrossRef’s Open Funder Registry list of academic research funding bodies, for example ‘10.13039/100010269’ (Wellcome Trust). Use of RORs for funder identifiers is now preferred. See https://www.crossref.org/services/funder-registry/

codes.heading: BNE CN
codes.notes: Control number assigned to a Name Authority record by the Biblioteca Nacional de España

codes.heading: BNF Control Number
codes.notes: Numéro de la notice de personne BNF

codes.heading: ARK
codes.notes: Archival Resource Key, as a URL (including the address of the ARK resolver provided by eg a national library)

codes.heading: Nasjonalt autoritetsregister
codes.notes: Nasjonalt autoritetsregister for navn – Norwegian national authority file for personal and corporate names. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: IDRef
codes.notes: Party ID from Identifiers and Standards for Higher Education and Research (fr: Identifiants et Référentiels pour l’enseignement supérieur et la recherche). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later. See https://www.idref.fr

codes.heading: IPI
codes.notes: Party ID from CISAC’s proprietary Interested Party Information scheme, used primarily in rights and royalties administration. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: ROR
codes.notes: Research organization registry identifier (see https://ror.org), leading 0 followed by 8 alphanumeric characters (including 2-digit checksum). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: EORI
codes.notes: Economic Operators Registration and Identification, identifier for businesses that import into or export from the EU. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: LEI
codes.notes: Legal Entity Identifier, administered by the Global LEI Foundation, as 20 alphanumeric characters without spaces or hyphens. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: SIREN
codes.notes: French business identifier, issued by the National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE). 9 digits, without spaces. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: SIRET
codes.notes: French business and location identifier, issued by the National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE). 14 digits (the SIREN plus a further five digits), without spaces, or occasionally an alphanumeric code. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Chinese Participant identifier
codes.notes: Chinese Participant identifier on the Publishing and distribution public service platform. 12-digits (or 11 digits plus X), usually presented with a / and hyphens dividing the number into groups of three, four and four digits plus a check digit, but in ONIX the / and hyphens should be omitted. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: EPR registration number
codes.notes: Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with EPR registration numbers, for example LUCID for Germany and CONAI for Italy. An organization may have many EPR registration numbers across multiple countries. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Co-publisher
codes.notes: Use where two or more publishers co-publish the exact same product, either under a single ISBN (in which case both publishers are co-publishers), or under different ISBNs (in which case the publisher of THIS ISBN is the publisher and the publishers of OTHER ISBNs are co-publishers. Note this is different from publication of ‘co-editions’

codes.heading: Publisher of original-language version
codes.notes: Of a translated work

codes.heading: Published in association with
codes.notes: Use also for ‘Published in cooperation with’

codes.heading: New or acquiring publisher
codes.notes: When ownership of a product is transferred from one publisher to another

codes.heading: Publishing group
codes.notes: The group to which a publisher (publishing role 01) belongs: use only if a publisher has been identified with role code 01

codes.heading: Publisher of facsimile original
codes.notes: The publisher of the edition of which a product is a facsimile

codes.heading: Repackager of prebound edition
codes.notes: The repackager of a prebound edition that has been assigned its own identifier. (In the US, a ‘prebound edition’ is a book that was previously bound, normally as a paperback, and has been rebound with a library-quality hardcover binding by a supplier other than the original publisher.) Required when the <EditionType> is coded PRB. The original publisher should be named as the ‘publisher’

codes.heading: Former publisher
codes.notes: When ownership of a product is transferred from one publisher to another (complement of code 09)

codes.heading: Publication funder
codes.notes: Body funding publication fees, if different from the body funding the underlying research. Intended primarily for use with open access publications

codes.heading: Research funder
codes.notes: Body funding the research on which publication is based, if different from the body funding the publication. Intended primarily for use with open access publications

codes.heading: Funding body
codes.notes: Body funding research and publication. Intended primarily for use with open access publications

codes.heading: Printer
codes.notes: Organization responsible for printing a printed product. Supplied primarily to meet legal deposit requirements, and may apply only to the first impression. The organization may also be responsible for binding, when a separate binder is not specified

codes.heading: Binder
codes.notes: Organization responsible for binding a printed product (where distinct from the printer). Supplied primarily to meet legal deposit requirements, and may apply only to the first impression

codes.heading: Manufacturer
codes.notes: Organization primarily responsible for physical manufacture of a product, when neither Printer nor Binder is directly appropriate (for example, with disc or tape products, or digital products on a physical carrier)

codes.heading: Previous publisher
codes.notes: Use for the publisher of earlier manifestations of the work. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Height
codes.notes: For a book, the overall height when standing on a shelf. For a folded map, the height when folded. For packaged products, the height of the retail packaging, and for trade-only products, the height of the trade packaging. In general, the height of a product in the form in which it is presented or packaged for retail sale

codes.heading: Width
codes.notes: For a book, the overall horizontal dimension of the cover when standing upright. For a folded map, the width when folded. For packaged products, the width of the retail packaging, and for trade-only products, the width of the trade packaging. In general, the width of a product in the form in which it is presented or packaged for retail sale

codes.heading: Thickness
codes.notes: For a book, the overall thickness of the spine. For a folded map, the thickness when folded. For packaged products, the depth of the retail packaging, and for trade-only products, the depth of the trade packaging. In general, the thickness or depth of a product in the form in which it is presented or packaged for retail sale

codes.heading: Page trim height
codes.notes: Overall height (code 01) is preferred for general use, as it includes the board overhang for hardbacks

codes.heading: Page trim width
codes.notes: Overall width (code 02) is preferred for general use, as it includes the board overhang and spine thickness for hardbacks

codes.heading: Unit volume
codes.notes: The volume of the product, including any retail packaging. Note the <MeasureUnit> is interpreted as a volumetric unit – for example code cm = cubic centimetres (ie millilitres), and code oz = (US) fluid ounces. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Unit capacity
codes.notes: Volume of the internal (fluid) contents of a product (eg of paint in a can). Note the <MeasureUnit> is interpreted as a volumetric unit – for example code cm = cubic centimetres (ie millilitres), and code oz = (US) fluid ounces. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Unit weight
codes.notes: The overall weight of the product, including any retail packaging

codes.heading: Diameter (sphere)
codes.notes: Of a globe, for example

codes.heading: Unfolded / unrolled sheet height
codes.notes: The height of a folded or rolled sheet map, poster etc when unfolded

codes.heading: Unfolded / unrolled sheet width
codes.notes: The width of a folded or rolled sheet map, poster etc when unfolded

codes.heading: Diameter (tube or cylinder)
codes.notes: The diameter of the cross-section of a tube or cylinder, usually carrying a rolled sheet product. Use 01 ‘Height’ for the height or length of the tube

codes.heading: Rolled sheet package side measure
codes.notes: The length of a side of the cross-section of a long triangular or square package, usually carrying a rolled sheet product. Use 01 ‘Height’ for the height or length of the package

codes.heading: Unpackaged height
codes.notes: As height, but of the product without packaging (use only for products supplied in retail packaging, must also supply overall size when packaged using code 01). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Unpackaged width
codes.notes: As width, but of the product without packaging (use only for products supplied in retail packaging, must also supply overall size when packaged using code 02). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Unpackaged thickness
codes.notes: As thickness, but of the product without packaging (use only for products supplied in retail packaging, must also supply overall size when packaged using code 03). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Total battery weight
codes.notes: Weight of batteries built-in, pre-installed or supplied with the product. Details of the batteries should be provided using <ProductFormFeature>. A per-battery unit weight may be calculated from the number of batteries if required. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Total weight of Lithium
codes.notes: Mass or equivalent mass of elemental Lithium within the batteries built-in, pre-installed or supplied with the product (eg a Lithium Iron phosphate battery with 160g of cathode material would have a total of around 7g of Lithium). Details of the batteries must be provided using <ProductFormFeature>. A per-battery unit mass of Lithium may be calculated from the number of batteries if required. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Assembled length
codes.notes: For use where product or part of product requires assembly, for example the size of a completed kit, puzzle or assembled display piece. The assembled dimensions may be larger than the product size as supplied. Use only when the unassembled dimensions as supplied (including any retail or trade packaging) are also provided using codes 01, 02 and 03. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Unpackaged unit weight
codes.notes: Overall unit weight (code 08) is preferred for general use, as it includes the weight of any packaging. Use Unpackaged unit weight only for products supplied in retail packaging, and must also supply overall unit weight. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Carton length
codes.notes: Includes packaging. See <PackQuantity> for number of copies of the product per pack, and used only when dimensions of individual copies (codes 01, 02, 03) AND <PackQuantity> are supplied. Note that neither orders nor deliveries have to be aligned with multiples of the pack quantity, but such orders and deliveries may be more convenient to handle. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Carton weight
codes.notes: Includes the weight of product(s) within the carton. See <PackQuantity> for number of copies per pack, and used only when the weight of individual copies (code 08) AND <PackQuantity> are supplied. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Pallet length
codes.notes: Includes pallet and packaging. See <PalletQuantity> for number of copies of the product per pallet, and used only when dimensions of individual copies (codes 01, 02, 03) AND <PalletQuantity> are supplied. Note that neither orders nor deliveries have to be aligned with multiples of the pallet quantity, but such orders and deliveries may be more convenient to handle. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Pallet weight
codes.notes: Includes the weight of product(s) and cartons stacked on the pallet. See <PalletQuantity> for the number of copies per pallet, and used only when the weight of individual copies (code 08) AND <PalletQuantity> are supplied. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Centimeters
codes.notes: Millimeters are the preferred metric unit of length

codes.heading: Kilograms
codes.notes: Grams are the preferred metric unit of weight

codes.heading: Pounds (US)
codes.notes: Ounces are the preferred US customary unit of weight

codes.heading: RRP excluding tax
codes.notes: Recommended Retail Price, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Price recommended by the publisher or supplier for retail sales to the consumer. Also termed the Suggested Retail Price (SRP) or Maximum Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) in some countries. The retailer may choose to use this recommended price, or may choose to sell to the consumer at a lower (or occasionally, a higher) price which is termed the Actual Selling Price (ASP) in sales reports. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the RRP minus a trade discount (which may be customer-specific). Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient

codes.heading: RRP including tax
codes.notes: Recommended Retail Price, including sales or value-added tax where applicable. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the trade discount. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite

codes.heading: FRP excluding tax
codes.notes: Fixed Retail Price, excluding any sales or value-added tax, used in countries where retail price maintenance applies (by law or via trade agreement) to certain products. Price fixed by the publisher or supplier for retail sales to the consumer. The retailer must use this price, or may vary the price only within certain legally-prescribed limits. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the FRP minus a customer-specific trade discount. Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient

codes.heading: FRP including tax
codes.notes: Fixed Retail Price, including any sales or value-added tax where applicable, used in countries where retail price maintenance applies (by law or via trade agreement) to certain products. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the trade discount. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite

codes.heading: Supplier’s Net price excluding tax
codes.notes: Net or wholesale price, excluding any sales or value-added tax. Unit price charged by supplier for business-to-business transactions, without any direct relationship to the price for retail sales to the consumer, but sometimes subject to a further customer-specific trade discount based on volume. Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient

codes.heading: Supplier’s Net price excluding tax: rental goods
codes.notes: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller / rental outlet, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax: goods for rental (used for video and DVD)

codes.heading: Supplier’s Net price including tax
codes.notes: Net or wholesale price, including any sales or value-added tax where applicable. Unit price charged by supplier for business-to-business transactions, without any direct relationship to the price for retail sales to the consumer, but sometimes subject to a further customer-specific trade discount based on volume. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite

codes.heading: Supplier’s alternative Net price excluding tax
codes.notes: Net or wholesale price charged by supplier to a specified class of reseller, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient. (This value is for use only in countries, eg Finland, where trade practice requires two different Net prices to be listed for different classes of resellers, and where national guidelines specify how the code should be used)

codes.heading: Supplier’s alternative net price including tax
codes.notes: Net or wholesale price charged by supplier to a specified class of reseller, including any sales tax or value-added tax. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite. (This value is for use only in countries, eg Finland, where trade practice requires two different Net prices to be listed for different classes of resellers, and where national guidelines specify how the code should be used)

codes.heading: Special sale RRP excluding tax
codes.notes: Special sale RRP excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Note ‘special sales’ are sales where terms and conditions are different from normal trade sales, when for example products that are normally sold on a sale-or-return basis are sold on firm-sale terms, where a particular product is tailored for a specific retail outlet (often termed a ‘premium’ product), or where other specific conditions or qualifications apply. Further details of the modified terms and conditions should be given in <PriceTypeDescription>

codes.heading: Special sale RRP including tax
codes.notes: Special sale RRP including sales or value-added tax if applicable

codes.heading: Special sale fixed retail price excluding tax
codes.notes: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

codes.heading: Special sale fixed retail price including tax
codes.notes: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

codes.heading: Supplier’s net price for special sale excluding tax
codes.notes: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller for special sale excluding any sales tax or value-added tax

codes.heading: Supplier’s net price for special sale including tax
codes.notes: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller for special sale including any sales tax or value-added tax

codes.heading: Pre-publication RRP excluding tax
codes.notes: Pre-publication RRP excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Use where RRP for pre-orders is different from post-publication RRP

codes.heading: Pre-publication RRP including tax
codes.notes: Pre-publication RRP including sales or value-added tax if applicable. Use where RRP for pre-orders is different from post-publication RRP

codes.heading: Pre-publication fixed retail price excluding tax
codes.notes: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

codes.heading: Pre-publication fixed retail price including tax
codes.notes: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

codes.heading: Supplier’s pre-publication net price excluding tax
codes.notes: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller pre-publication excluding any sales tax or value-added tax

codes.heading: Supplier’s pre-publication net price including tax
codes.notes: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller pre-publication including any sales tax or value-added tax

codes.heading: Freight-pass-through RRP excluding tax
codes.notes: In the US, books are sometimes supplied on ‘freight-pass-through’ terms, where a price that is different from the RRP is used as the basis for calculating the supplier’s charge to a reseller. To make it clear when such terms are being invoked, code 31 is used instead of code 01 to indicate the RRP. Code 32 is used for the ‘billing price’

codes.heading: Freight-pass-through billing price excluding tax
codes.notes: When freight-pass-through terms apply, the price on which the supplier’s charge to a reseller is calculated, ie the price to which trade discount terms are applied. See also code 31

codes.heading: Importer’s Fixed retail price excluding tax
codes.notes: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products, but the price is set by the importer or local sales agent, not the foreign publisher. In France, ‘prix catalogue éditeur étranger’

codes.heading: Importer’s Fixed retail price including tax
codes.notes: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products, but the price is set by the importer or local sales agent, not the foreign publisher. In France, ‘prix catalogue éditeur étranger’

codes.heading: Nominal gratis copy value for customs purposes, excluding tax
codes.notes: Nominal value of gratis copies (eg review, sample or evaluation copies) for international customs declarations only, when a ‘free of charge’ price cannot be used. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Nominal value for claims purposes, excluding tax
codes.notes: Nominal value of copies for claims purposes only (eg to account for copies lost during distribution). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Nominal value for customs purposes, excluding tax
codes.notes: Nominal value of copies (Declared Unit Value) for international customs declarations only. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Publishers retail price excluding tax
codes.notes: For a product supplied on agency terms, the retail price set by the publisher, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax

codes.heading: Publishers retail price including tax
codes.notes: For a product supplied on agency terms, the retail price set by the publisher, including sales or value-added tax if applicable

codes.heading: Unspecified
codes.notes: Status is not specified (as distinct from unknown): the default if the <PublishingStatus> element is not sent. Also to be used in applications where the element is considered mandatory, but the sender of the ONIX message chooses not to pass on status information

codes.heading: Cancelled
codes.notes: The product was announced, and subsequently abandoned; the <PublicationDate> element in ONIX 2.1 or its equivalent in <PublishingDate> in ONIX 3.0 or later must not be sent

codes.heading: Forthcoming
codes.notes: Not yet published; must be accompanied by the expected date in <PublicationDate> in ONIX 2.1, or its equivalent in the <PublishingDate> composite in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Postponed indefinitely
codes.notes: The product was announced, and subsequently postponed with no expected publication date; the <PublicationDate> element in ONIX 2.1, or its equivalent as a <PublishingDate> composite in ONIX 3.0 or later, must not be sent

codes.heading: Active
codes.notes: The product was published, and is still active in the sense that the publisher will accept orders for it, though it may or may not be immediately available, for which see <SupplyDetail>

codes.heading: No longer our product
codes.notes: Ownership of the product has been transferred to another publisher (with details of acquiring publisher if possible in PR.19 (ONIX 2.1) OR P.19 (ONIX 3.0 or later))

codes.heading: Out of stock indefinitely
codes.notes: The product was active, but is now inactive in the sense that (a) the publisher cannot fulfill orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain, and (b) there are no current plans to bring it back into stock. Use this code for ‘reprint under consideration’. Code 06 does not specifically imply that returns are or are not still accepted

codes.heading: Out of print
codes.notes: The product was active, but is now permanently inactive in the sense that (a) the publisher will not accept orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain, and (b) the product will not be made available again under the same ISBN. Code 07 normally implies that the publisher will not accept returns beyond a specified date

codes.heading: Inactive
codes.notes: The product was active, but is now permanently or indefinitely inactive in the sense that the publisher will not accept orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain. Code 08 covers both of codes 06 and 07, and may be used where the distinction between those values is either unnecessary or meaningless

codes.heading: Unknown
codes.notes: The sender of the ONIX record does not know the current publishing status

codes.heading: Remaindered
codes.notes: The product is no longer available from the current publisher, under the current ISBN, at the current price. It may be available to be traded through another channel. A Publishing Status code 10 ‘Remaindered’ usually but not always means that the publisher has decided to sell off excess inventory of the book. Copies of books that are remaindered are often made available in the supply chain at a reduced price. However, such remainders are often sold under a product identifier that differs from the ISBN on the full-priced copy of the book. A Publishing Status code 10 ‘Remaindered’ on a given product record may or may not be followed by a Publishing Status code 06 ‘Out of Stock Indefinitely’ or 07 ‘Out of Print’: the practice varies from one publisher to another. Some publishers may revert to a Publishing Status code 04 ‘Active’ if a desired inventory level on the product in question has subsequently been reached. No change in rights should ever be inferred from this (or any other) Publishing Status code value

codes.heading: Withdrawn from sale
codes.notes: Withdrawn, typically for legal reasons or to avoid giving offence

codes.heading: Active, but not sold separately
codes.notes: The product is published and active but, as a publishing decision, its constituent parts are not sold separately – only in an assembly or as part of a pack, eg with Product composition code 01. Also use with Product composition codes 30, 31 where depending on product composition and pricing, items in the pack may or may not be saleable separately at retail

codes.heading: Recalled
codes.notes: Recalled for reasons of consumer safety

codes.heading: Temporarily withdrawn from sale
codes.notes: Withdrawn temporarily, typically for quality or technical reasons. In ONIX 3.0 or later, must be accompanied by expected availability date coded ‘22’ within the <PublishingDate> composite, except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known

codes.heading: Permanently withdrawn from sale
codes.notes: Withdrawn permanently from sale in all markets. Effectively synonymous with ‘Out of print’ (code 07), but specific to downloadable and online digital products (where no ‘stock’ would remain in the supply chain)

codes.heading: Active, but not sold as set
codes.notes: The various constituent parts of a product are published and active but, as a publishing decision, they are not sold together as a single product – eg with Product composition code 11 – and are only available as a number of individual items. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Cancelled
codes.notes: Product was announced, and subsequently abandoned by the publisher. No expected availability date should be included in <SupplyDate>

codes.heading: Not yet available, postponed indefinitely
codes.notes: Product is not yet available from the supplier, and the publisher indicates that it has been postponed indefinitely. Should be used in preference to code 10 where the publisher has indicated that a previously-announced publication date is no longer correct, and no new date has yet been announced. No expected availability date should be included in <SupplyDate>. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

codes.heading: Not yet available
codes.notes: Product is not yet available (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

codes.heading: Awaiting stock
codes.notes: Product is not yet available, but will be a stock item when available (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known). Used particularly for imports which have been published in the country of origin but have not yet arrived in the importing country

codes.heading: Not yet available, will be POD
codes.notes: Product is not yet available, to be published as print-on-demand only (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known). May apply either to a POD successor to an existing conventional edition, when the successor will be published under a different ISBN (normally because different trade terms apply); or to a title that is being published as a POD original

codes.heading: Available
codes.notes: Product is available from the supplier (form of availability unspecified)

codes.heading: In stock
codes.notes: Product is available from the supplier as a stock item

codes.heading: To order
codes.notes: Product is available from the supplier as a non-stock item, by special order. Where possible, an <OrderTime> should be included

codes.heading: POD
codes.notes: Product is available from the supplier by print-on-demand. If the fulfillment delay is likely to be more than 24 hours, an <OrderTime> should be included

codes.heading: Temporarily unavailable
codes.notes: Product is temporarily unavailable: temporarily unavailable from the supplier (reason unspecified) (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

codes.heading: Out of stock
codes.notes: Product is stock item, but is temporarily out of stock (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

codes.heading: Reprinting
codes.notes: Product is temporarily unavailable, and is reprinting (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

codes.heading: Awaiting reissue
codes.notes: Product is temporarily unavailable, awaiting reissue (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

codes.heading: Temporarily withdrawn from sale
codes.notes: Product is temporarily withdrawn from sale, possibly for quality or technical reasons. Requires expected availability date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known

codes.heading: Not available (reason unspecified)
codes.notes: Product is not available from the supplier (for any reason)

codes.heading: Not available, replaced by new product
codes.notes: Product is unavailable, but a successor product or edition is or will be available from the supplier (identify successor in <RelatedProduct>)

codes.heading: Not available, other format available
codes.notes: Product is unavailable, but the same content is or will be available from the supplier in an alternative format (identify other format product in <RelatedProduct>)

codes.heading: No longer supplied by the supplier
codes.notes: Product is no longer available from the supplier. Identify new supplier in <NewSupplier> if possible

codes.heading: Apply direct
codes.notes: Product is not available to trade, apply direct to publisher

codes.heading: Not sold separately
codes.notes: Product must be bought as part of a set or trade pack (identify set or pack in <RelatedProduct> using code 02). Individual copies of the product are not available from the supplier, but packs of copies are available, and individual copies of the product may typically be sold at retail

codes.heading: Withdrawn from sale
codes.notes: Product is withdrawn from sale, possibly permanently. May be for legal reasons or to avoid giving offence

codes.heading: Remaindered
codes.notes: Product has been remaindered and is no longer available from the supplier in the normal way, but may be available under different terms and conditions in order to dispose of excess stock

codes.heading: Not available, replaced by POD
codes.notes: Product is out of print, but a print-on-demand edition is or will be available under a different ISBN. Use only when the POD successor has a different ISBN, normally because different trade terms apply

codes.heading: Recalled
codes.notes: Product has been recalled, possibly for reasons of consumer safety

codes.heading: Not sold as set
codes.notes: Contents of set or pack must be bought as individual items (identify contents of set or pack in <RelatedProduct> using code 01). Used when a collection that is not sold as a set nevertheless has its own ONIX record

codes.heading: Not available, publisher indicates OP
codes.notes: Product is unavailable from the supplier, no successor product or alternative format is available or planned. Use this code only when the publisher has indicated the product is out of print

codes.heading: Not available, publisher no longer sells product in this market
codes.notes: Product is unavailable from the supplier in this market, no successor product or alternative format is available or planned. Use this code when a publisher has indicated the product is permanently unavailable (in this market) while remaining available elsewhere

codes.heading: No recent update received
codes.notes: Sender has not received any recent update for this product from the publisher or supplier (for use when the sender is a data aggregator). The definition of ‘recent’ must be specified by the aggregator, or by agreement between parties to an exchange

codes.heading: No longer receiving updates
codes.notes: Sender is no longer receiving any updates from the publisher or supplier of this product (for use when the sender is a data aggregator)
